description: Test file for the streaming server component of Kubernetes CRI, including tests for GetExec, GetAttach, GetPortForward, and remote command execution.

methods.name: TestGetExec
methods.description: Tests the GetExec method for different server configurations and URL formations.

methods.name: TestValidateExecAttachRequest
methods.description: Validates the logic for exec and attach request configurations.

methods.name: TestGetAttach
methods.description: Tests the GetAttach method for different server configurations.

methods.name: TestGetPortForward
methods.description: Tests the GetPortForward method for both TLS and non-TLS servers.

methods.name: startTestServer
methods.description: Initializes a test server with a fake runtime for testing server methods.

methods.name: runRemoteCommandTest
methods.description: Performs remote command execution or attach test depending on parameter.

methods.name: newFakeRuntime
methods.description: Creates a fake runtime implementation for testing.

methods.name: doServerStreams
methods.description: Simulates server-side streaming of input/output for testing.

methods.name: doClientStreams
methods.description: Simulates client-side streaming of input/output for testing.

methods.name: readExpected
methods.description: Verifies expected data received from stream.

methods.name: writeExpected
methods.description: Sends expected data to stream and verifies success.
